config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_COMBINE: not supported: combined mutations (mutations.combine) are not implemented; a mutation changes a single path
config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_PARALLELISM: not supported: sequential execution only (parallelism: 1); no adapter is verified parallelSafe
config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_ISOLATION: not supported: only per-process isolation (isolation: process) exists
config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_RESET_ENVIRONME: not supported: each mutation runs in a fresh process, the environment is always reset (environment: true)
config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_RESET_MOCKS: not supported: each mutation runs in a fresh process, mocks are always reset (mocks: true)
config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_RESET_FILESYSTE: not supported: filesystem: copy (project copy) is not implemented; use none or tmpdir
config.issue.UNSUPPORTED_STORE_RAW_VALUE: not supported: raw values are never stored (store_raw_values: false)
config.issue.ACCEPTANCE_ITEMS_WITH_DB_ST: refused: with store: db, acceptances live in the database; items in varia.yml would be ignored
